scope: Confirmed external behaviors only. Every setup vector and table row is mandatory, not a menu from which the executor chooses the easiest case. Formal business values remain pending-business-inputs.json dependencies.
assessment_rule: For every ID, identify concrete pre-state/mode/actor, act at supported user/external boundary and compare visible outcome. Exception, boundary, transition and interaction vectors appear where the confirmed behavior makes them relevant. Independent reviewer must still challenge omitted vectors.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Owner orders in unpaid, paid/unshipped, partly shipped and delivered states; record applicable cancellation policy and another customer's order.
items.action_and_variants: Owner opens cancellation for each order, submits where eligible, refreshes status; repeat with the other customer's order through its known link.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Eligibility and refusal reason match each current state; submission shows processing rather than a fabricated completed cancellation; no other-customer access.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Unpaid order with two lines, stock, limited promotion and points held and no payment in flight; separate paid order with one unshipped and one shipped line, in each payment mode.
items.action_and_variants: Authorized staff approves cancellation, then repeats the approval; inspect order, inventory and benefits. For unpaid order attempt to buy retained goods again; for paid order cancel only eligible line.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Unpaid order closes all lines, releases all holds once and requires new quote/order for repurchase. Paid order cancels only eligible line and creates refund pending in original mode, never claims refunded; shipped line unchanged; reason recorded.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Owner with purchased unprocessed quantities; guest ownership verified and member ownership established in separate runs. Prepare return, exchange target and damaged-package evidence, plus each required field omitted in turn.
items.action_and_variants: Submit each application type through order-line after-sales entry; correct missing fields and resubmit; reopen the resulting case.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Queryable case binds correct line, quantity, type, reason and evidence; exchange identifies target; damage identifies package. Incomplete application identifies missing required data rather than losing it or fabricating evidence.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Order line bought quantity 3 with quantity 1 already processed; remaining 2. Reset separate runs for claims of 1, 2 and 3; concurrent claims of 2 against same remaining quantity.
items.action_and_variants: Owner submits return/exchange requests at each quantity and in two sessions concurrently; reload cases and remaining entitlement.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Claims cannot exceed remaining 2 individually or collectively; excess refused with available quantity; already processed units cannot be claimed again.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Order under policy V1; current policy V2 differs. Prepare times just inside, exactly at and just outside V1 cutoff, and eligible/ineligible item condition per V1.
items.action_and_variants: Owner submits return and exchange applications for each vector and opens rejection details.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Eligibility uses V1's explicit inclusive/exclusive rule and conditions; disallowed applications show original policy and specific reason, never substitute V2. Undefined boundary semantics are recorded as a missing execution oracle.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Pending return and exchange cases with supporting data; authorized reviewer identity; accepted and rejected branches in separate fresh cases.
items.action_and_variants: Reviewer accepts or rejects with reason; owner reopens case and staff history.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Decision, reason, reviewer and time persist; customer sees corresponding next step, not the opposite branch or an unexplained status.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Two cases with distinct order lines and bicycle serial numbers; one item physically received, the other only in transit; condition and inspection evidence recorded in fixture.
items.action_and_variants: Receiving staff records actual receipt and inspection of first item with pass/fail conclusions in separate runs; inspect both cases.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Received serial/line, condition, evidence and refund/exchange conclusion persist on correct case; mere shipment is not represented as inspected receipt; second case remains unchanged.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Paid multi-unit line with discount, points, tax, shipping and rounding allocation; prior partial refund and pending reserve. Two exchanges have separate confirmed top-ups; real/test modes separately. Compute per-source remaining limits from original snapshot.
items.action_and_variants: Staff requests approval at the calculated limit and one currency minor unit over each unit/line/order/source limit; try using exchange A top-up for case B, and an unconfirmed top-up.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Approval records amount basis, currency, mode and approver; approved amount never exceeds eligible unprocessed quantity or any remaining limit; top-up balance belongs only to its case; current prices cannot inflate original refund.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Approved refund distributed across original payment and case top-up, with distinct references; run real and isolated test modes; observe recipient's transaction history through supported boundary.
items.action_and_variants: Authorized staff executes refund twice including double-click/retry; inspect each source's receiver history and case references.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: One refund per approved allocation via its original mode; separate original-payment and refund references saved. Test creates only isolated simulated refunds and no real receiver request.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Approved refund accepted by receiver but response withheld; another refund competes for remaining source balance.
items.action_and_variants: Staff executes first refund, reloads pending case, retries execution and requests overlapping refund.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Case remains pending reconciliation with original reference and reserved amount; same refund is not dispatched again and competing approval cannot spend the reservation.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Two delivered bicycle order lines with verified distinct serials; prepare same serial for attempted second association.
items.action_and_variants: Staff binds serial to first line, repeats same binding and attempts binding it to the other line; reopen both records.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Serial refers to exact delivered line without duplicate associations; second-line conflict is restricted and first association remains correct.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Order under warranty V1, public policy V2 differs; fixtures eligible, outside V1 coverage and missing purchase/serial evidence.
items.action_and_variants: Owner submits warranty claim for each fixture, reads assessment, supplies requested missing evidence and resubmits.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Eligibility reflects published applicable policy and original order snapshot; insufficient data prompts specific supplementation, not an invented approval/refusal; reassessment uses supplied evidence.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Warranty/repair case with diagnosed issue; repair and replacement outcomes and chargeable/free policy branches in independent runs.
items.action_and_variants: Staff records diagnosis, responsibility, result and fee basis, then actual return/disposition; owner follows progress before and after return.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: All diagnosis, responsibility, repair/replacement result, fee basis and handback states persist; completion is not inferred from diagnosis alone.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Approved cases affecting stock, promotion and points; preserve original order snapshot; include two events cancel then refund for same entitlement.
items.action_and_variants: Staff performs approved adjustments, replays same action and processes subsequent related event; inspect inventory, benefit/points histories and original order.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Each adjustment names source case; entitlement changes only by remaining justified amount; repeated or overlapping events do not double-adjust; original snapshot is byte/field equivalent at visible export boundary.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Fresh case per source-state/edge in confirmed after-sales-18 table, including all six exchange pre-shipment termination states. Required payment, inspection, original-item custody and fulfillment evidence can be made satisfied or independently unsatisfied.
items.action_and_variants: For EVERY listed arrow, staff performs its named business action with prerequisites satisfied and reads persisted state/history; repeat with each prerequisite missing. For each source state request every unlisted target offered by UI or supported boundary; use no guessed internal endpoint.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Exactly listed transitions with prerequisites succeed; skipped review/inspection, unfinished refund, undelivered replacement and unresolved original-item custody cannot reach terminal state. Source and time persist; unavailable illegal controls and rejected boundary requests count as observable rejection.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Three allocations in one case: successful, definitively failed, uncertain. Failure reason and source reserve recorded.
items.action_and_variants: Staff reconciles failure, requests reapproval/retry for failed allocation, attempts retry before reapproval and attempts re-executing successful/uncertain allocations.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Failure reason remains on original case, failed reserve releases once; only failed and reapproved allocation retries; successful money and uncertain reservation remain unchanged.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Refund carrying money, stock and points consequences; original balances and receiver reference recorded; two copies of execution and successful result.
items.action_and_variants: Execute/refeed duplicates serially and concurrently through supported receiver test facility; inspect refund amount, stock, points and reconciliation history.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Money, inventory and points adjust once only; duplicate-event reconciliation record is visible to authorized staff.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Approved return/exchange under V1 with address, packaging/disassembly, cost payer and deadline known; V2 differs. Omit each required condition separately.
items.action_and_variants: Owner opens return instructions after approval, then each missing-condition case; restore condition and reopen.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Instructions use V1 destination, bicycle handling, payer and deadline; each missing input blocks shipping instructions and identifies missing condition; restored complete case provides them.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Inspected original item and target quote; fixtures target cost above, below and equal original refundable amount; original discounts allocated.
items.action_and_variants: Owner selects target, views calculated difference and attempts shipment before confirming settlement; then confirms displayed arrangement.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Difference compares original refundable amount with current target quote; shipment blocked before confirmation; positive/negative/zero branch stated accurately without silently using original list price.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Approved exchange; baseline inspected goods, valid target hold, settled difference and fulfillment authorization. Omit each individually; separate target stock failure.
items.action_and_variants: Staff requests replacement fulfillment for each vector and opens customer case/package list.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only fully qualified case requests traceable replacement package; stock failure exposes change-target/refund paths; each other missing prerequisite leaves pending case with no replacement package.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Cases for unpaid cancellation, paid cancellation, return refund, exchange, warranty and repair. For each prepare fulfilled result and one unmet completion condition in table, including unsettled received original.
items.action_and_variants: Staff attempts Mark complete in both branches and customer reopens case.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Unpaid cancellation needs all lines closed/stock released; refund needs all sources successful; exchange needs replacement delivered; repair needs fulfilled return/disposition; unmet conditions refuse completion and preserve pending state.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Approved refund with two sources; first succeeds and second remains pending; real and isolated test modes, original order refund totals recorded.
items.action_and_variants: Staff verifies first result through original receiver reference, then rechecks same result; finally verify second success.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only corresponding source reservation becomes refunded balance, once; partial success does not complete case; complete only after both successes; source result evidence and actual/test distinction persist.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Order payment pending reconciliation with inventory, promotion and points held; receiver might already have charged.
items.action_and_variants: Owner requests cancellation and staff tries approval before reconciliation; inspect order, holds and case.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Case becomes pending payment reconciliation; inventory stays held, order is not described as cancelled/refunded; reconciliation required before next decision.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Cross customer withdrawal/inability to fulfill with original never shipped/in transit/received and no top-up/confirmed unrefunded top-up; target reserved; replacement not shipped. Include already-shipped replacement control.
items.action_and_variants: Customer withdraws or staff confirms failure with reason; inspect holds, original disposition, top-up refund task and customer status; repeat action.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Target hold releases once; reason/request time/responsible person retained; unrefunded top-up linked to case and original transaction becomes pending refund. Only never-sent original with no refund due can terminate immediately; other cases await settlement; shipped case cannot use this pre-shipment route.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Fresh cases per difference sign, real/test mode and receiver success/failure/unknown. Preserve original snapshot; positive case has confirmed arrangement identifier.
items.action_and_variants: Customer confirms price difference twice; staff checks receiver outcome and attempts fulfillment. For definitive failure customer reconfirms; for unknown retry reconciliation instead of payment.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Positive arrangement initiates once, records confirmed amount/currency/mode/reference on success; failure can reconfirm, unknown cannot debit again/ship. Negative settles only all refunds successful; zero records confirmation without money action; original snapshot unchanged.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Uncertain refund and top-up cases; receiver fixtures success, failure and still unknown, same original attempt references in real/test modes.
items.action_and_variants: Authorized staff invokes reconciliation and repeats query; compare receiver query reference and updated case.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Queries original attempt; success/failure follow refund/top-up branches, unknown remains pending with no second refund/debit. Already-successful allocations stay intact.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Approved inspected exchange with target stock N; controls unapproved, uninspected and missing target; two eligible cases compete for last unit.
items.action_and_variants: Staff requests target reservation twice and concurrently against last unit, then opens case and inventory histories.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Eligible case gets one linked target hold; no oversell, duplicate hold or premature hold for missing prerequisites; failure remains pending, blocks package and offers change target/refund.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Cross desired rejected/terminated/completed with original never sent/in transit/received-disposition-unfulfilled/disposition-fulfilled and refund none/all success/one failed/one unknown.
items.action_and_variants: Staff attempts terminal action, then separately completes only money, only original disposition, and finally both; customer opens money and original-item history.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Terminal allowed only when BOTH obligations settled; unresolved original stays awaiting disposition/termination settlement or original state; failed/unknown money prevents closure; public case shows actual money and disposition records.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Original payment and two confirmed top-ups with different cases/modes; one unconfirmed top-up. Record each received amount minus successful refunds and other pending reservations; two approvals race for last refundable minor unit.
items.action_and_variants: Approve exact balance, then over by one minor unit, duplicate approval identifier, concurrent separate approvals and cross-case/transaction/mode transfers.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Each allocation binds eligible confirmed source and reserves once; aggregate accepted reservations never exceed that source balance; cross-source or mode borrowing and unconfirmed top-up refused with basis saved.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Case with original-payment and top-up allocations; vectors success+unknown, success+pending, success+failure, all-success, and failure+unknown/pending.
items.action_and_variants: Staff executes/reconciles one source at a time in different arrival orders, refreshes case, and attempts retry on each source.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Unknown takes precedence, then pending, then failed, then complete only if all success; per-source outcomes retained; successful sources never re-execute and unknown cannot retry; only failed reapproved allocation can retry.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Published bicycle with two sizes at different prices plus accessory; enabled markets with distinct currencies; stock available.
items.action_and_variants: Guest and member select each variant, add specified quantity and reopen cart.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Each line shows exact selected variant, quantity, market currency and displayed price; similarly named variants are not substituted.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Two cart lines, target stock N greater than 1; known prices. Independent quantities 1, N and N+1.
items.action_and_variants: Customer increases/decreases quantity, requests N+1, deletes one line then last line; refresh after each.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Valid changes preserve line/recalculate subtotal and total; excess rejected; deleting removes only selected line and subtotal; empty cart has no stale total.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Guest/member cart with four lines: unchanged, subsequently unpublished, now out of stock and repriced in current market.
items.action_and_variants: Leave shopping, apply each controlled catalog change as staff, then return in original browsing context and reopen cart.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Still-valid lines restored; unavailable and changed-price lines clearly identified; old price or stock is not silently represented as current.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Cart quoted in enabled market A; B changes one price/currency and makes another line unavailable; old checkout tab remains open.
items.action_and_variants: Customer switches A to B, inspects cart and submits old tab quote; confirm new valid quote after resolving unavailable item.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Every line is rechecked for B; old quote cannot submit unchanged; difference/unavailability shown with correct B currency.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Signed-out browser with sellable cart and synthetic contact/address, no account; all market inputs supplied.
items.action_and_variants: Proceed to checkout, enter contact and shipping address, advance toward final quote without registering.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Guest can provide required information and proceed; no mandatory account creation or hidden login gate.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Member A has two saved addresses, B has different private address; cart prepared.
items.action_and_variants: A checks out once selecting each saved address and once entering a new address; review destination and quote.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Chosen address is used correctly; new address entry works; B's addresses never offered.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Approved market/address schema and delivery coverage; valid covered address, one required field absent per run, valid but uncovered destination and disabled market.
items.action_and_variants: Guest/member submits each address then corrects it to covered valid address.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Missing fields and uncovered destination identified; invalid destination cannot advance as deliverable; corrected covered address proceeds.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Validated address with two eligible services and one ineligible service under current rules; another address/cart changes eligibility and cost.
items.action_and_variants: Customer opens delivery options, selects each eligible service and changes address/cart; inspect recalculated offer.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only applicable options with rule-derived fee and supported estimate appear; customer choice is explicit and reflected in quote; stale service not retained when inapplicable.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Published promo with known market/product/customer/period/stacking rules; valid, invalid code, expired and inapplicable vectors; limited quota exhausted control.
items.action_and_variants: Customer applies each promo at checkout, combines permitted and forbidden offers and views totals/errors.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Eligible discount matches rule; invalid/expired/inapplicable reasons distinct; forbidden stacking or exhausted quota cannot reduce total.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Mixed bicycle/accessory cart with discount, optional points, selected shipping; approved tax and allocation rules. Three destinations: taxable, explicitly zero/exempt, unknown rule.
items.action_and_variants: Guest/member completes checkout data for each; independently calculate components from fixture rules and compare displayed quote.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Goods, discounts, applicable points, shipping, tax, total and currency reconcile; zero shows basis; missing tax basis blocks payable quote rather than assuming zero.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Open confirmed quote in one tab. In separate vectors change price, stock, promo, tax and shipping, then combined price+stock+promo changes before submit.
items.action_and_variants: Customer submits stale quote, reads differences, declines once then confirms revised valid quote.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Old/new differences shown and fresh customer confirmation required; unavailable stock cannot proceed; declining cannot create payment at new total.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Otherwise-ready cart; independently disable target market, remove destination tax/delivery/after-sales rule or payment readiness; combine two missing inputs.
items.action_and_variants: Customer attempts final payment submission and opens missing-input explanation.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: No payment dispatch for each gap; affected destination/item/mode and missing business condition shown; configuration absence not converted into a default policy.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Persisted payable order and required holds; real mode with all lines ready/one line no longer ready; test mode ready/not ready; observe receiver attempts.
items.action_and_variants: Customer presses Pay after readiness changes and views mode label and receiver history.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only ready corresponding mode invoked; any unready real line blocks whole payment; ready test routes isolated simulation with explicit label and zero real requests.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Valid pending order in real/test mode with inventory and four benefit vectors: neither, promo only, points only, both. Receiver confirms exact amount/currency/reference.
items.action_and_variants: Customer completes payment, staff reconciles result and repeats result delivery; inspect order and both benefit histories together.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Order becomes paid with correct mode/confirmed amount/currency/reference; only used holds convert once, no partial visible state where paid order retains unconfirmed used benefit; test money not real receipts.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Pending order in each payment mode with neither/promo/points/both benefits; receiver definitive failure.
items.action_and_variants: Customer pays and sees failure, refreshes and retries failure delivery; inspect order, inventory and used benefit balances.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Failure status and retryable checkout retained; inventory and actual used benefits release once; unused benefits unaffected, no paid claim.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Two customer tabs on same confirmed quote; known stock and optional promotion/points; success and failure payment-result branches separately.
items.action_and_variants: Double-submit quote concurrently and resend same payment attempt result serially/concurrently; reload orders and all balances.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: One pending order and one set of holds; each result creates one payment/benefit use or reversal effect tied to original attempt; independent genuine quotes remain distinct.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Failed order snapshot retained; change price and stock after failure; include now-unavailable variant and changed promo.
items.action_and_variants: Customer clicks Retry, views new offer, first declines and then confirms valid new quote.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Current price/availability checked; new related pending order/holds only after confirmation; original failed order and snapshot unchanged; unavailable item blocks retry order.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Isolated test quote and payment service ready; real receiver transaction baseline known.
items.action_and_variants: Customer reaches confirmation, pays and opens result/receipt; staff views payment and fulfillment status.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Before and after payment explicitly says test/no real charge; simulated success not real receipt or real-shipping authorization; receiver has no real debit.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Real/test cart with two lines and none/promo/points/both benefits. Force shortage independently in stock, promo, points, and test resource; one real line unready. Separate all-ready fixture.
items.action_and_variants: Customer submits confirmed quote including two concurrent attempts for final resource; inspect order list, receiver attempts and all balances before/after.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Success saves snapshot and same-mode holds together. Any required failure produces no payable order or payment and no orphan holds, identifies affected line/reason, never borrows live resources for test.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Receiver accepts payment but result cannot yet be confirmed; order has inventory and optional benefits held.
items.action_and_variants: Customer pays, reloads and retries Pay; staff opens reconciliation queue and attempts fulfillment; advance past hold deadline.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Order remains pending reconciliation with original reference, staff task and holds; no second charge or physical fulfillment; elapsed deadline alone does not release holds.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Receiver success with original order, inventory hold, used promo hold or used points hold independently invalid; unused-benefit missing control.
items.action_and_variants: Staff reconciles success, attempts shipment/payment again, then separately repairs original state or verifies original-mode refund.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Affected case stays unresolved with staff task until repair or successful refund; no second charge or physical fulfillment meanwhile; absent unused benefits must not manufacture an exception.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Configured deadline T; order not started payment and another pending reconciliation; each with optional promo/points. Observe just before T, at T and after T using controlled test clock or scheduled waiting.
items.action_and_variants: Customer/staff views expiration results and attempts submission at each point; repeat expiration processing.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Verified-unstarted order expires at configured boundary and releases inventory/used benefits once; before deadline stays valid; uncertain payment never auto-releases even after T.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Uncertain original attempt with receiver success-valid holds, success-invalid holds, definite failure or still unknown, in both modes.
items.action_and_variants: Authorized staff invokes reconciliation twice; inspect query reference, original order, holds and exception queue.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Queries original reference; valid success paid, invalid success repair/refund exception, failure releases, unknown holds/no second charge; no unrelated order advanced.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Brand, technical and riding articles in enabled languages A/B, plus drafts and withdrawn articles.
items.action_and_variants: Visitor opens content entry in A then B and navigates each category.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Lists include only published content in active language and correct category; no draft/withdrawn leakage.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Published article with title/body/time and related published and unpublished products.
items.action_and_variants: Visitor opens article and follows each displayed product link.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Title, complete body and publication time match published version; related product links lead to published products, not private drafts.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Draft, scheduled-not-yet-published and withdrawn article URLs known; employee can view histories.
items.action_and_variants: Anonymous visitor uses list, navigation and direct URL, including a previously saved withdrawn link; authorized editor opens history.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: No nonpublic body exposed on public routes; withdrawal keeps staff-visible history.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Article with licensed external video, known title, cover or permitted alternative description and source platform.
items.action_and_variants: Visitor opens article and activates video playback entry; repeat with cover absent but alternative description present.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Title and cover/alternative visible; playback entry usable; external source identified accurately.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Article with readable text before/after video; invalid video URL and embedding unavailable in separate vectors.
items.action_and_variants: Visitor loads article, attempts playback, scrolls and reads remainder during failure.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Understandable video fallback; article text remains readable and navigable without false playback success.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Authorized editor and unauthorized/anonymous session; draft with unique revision marker.
items.action_and_variants: Editor changes text, saves, reopens and previews; anonymous/unauthorized user opens preview link.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Saved draft revision persists, preview only authorized; public content not prematurely changed.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Promo rules specify market, product, start/end, customer qualification, stacking and total/per-customer limits; eligible/ineligible customers and one remaining quota.
items.action_and_variants: Staff publishes, customer views offer before/start/inside/end per configured boundary, in each market/product/qualification combination, with quota free/fully held.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Saved rule fields preserved; only qualified customers with unheld quota see usable promise; out-of-scope or capacity-held customers do not.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Existing pending order with valid promo reservation; new checkout without reservation. Independently reach end time, withdraw promo and consume/hold final quota.
items.action_and_variants: Existing customer completes confirmed held quote; new customer views/applies offer after each transition.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: New purchase cannot apply unavailable promo or see usable promise; still-valid existing hold honored at confirmed quote rather than retroactively removed.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Enabled markets A/B with distinct effective and future policies for contact, delivery, assembly, returns, warranty, privacy and terms.
items.action_and_variants: Visitor opens every listed policy page in both markets, then after controlled effective-time transition.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Every page identifies applicable market, effective version and time; future/other-market version not substituted.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Editor draft V1 and revised V2; anonymous session with content entry open.
items.action_and_variants: Authorized employee publishes V2, visitor refreshes list and opens article, editor checks publication history.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: V2 enters public entry with recorded publication time; V1 is not mistakenly published as latest.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Published article reachable through list/navigation/direct URL; editor history available.
items.action_and_variants: Authorized employee withdraws; visitor revisits all routes and saved link; editor reopens history.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Withdrawal time persists and content stops being public while staff history remains.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Published total quota with one free unit and per-customer remaining one; existing holds accounted for; separate live/test pools.
items.action_and_variants: Two customers submit quotes concurrently for final total slot; same customer uses two tabs for per-customer slot; repeat test order against empty test quota with live quota free.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Accepted holds never exceed either cap; each tied to order/mode; test does not consume live quota; losing checkout gets no payable order with missing quota.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Two orders with distinct promo holds; receiver success for first, unknown/failure for second.
items.action_and_variants: Reconcile first payment repeatedly and open authorized promo usage/order history.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: First hold converts once to used; second untouched until its verified success; no double decrement on duplicate success.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Independent reserved orders for verified failure, no-payment timeout, prepayment cancellation and uncertain payment; include another order's hold.
items.action_and_variants: Perform each customer/staff action causing release twice; inspect quota and reservation history.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only first three release their own quota once; uncertain payment retains quota; other order unaffected.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Unused synthetic contact, already-registered contact, invalid contact, valid and invalid/expired verification proof per configured channel.
items.action_and_variants: Visitor registers each, attempts completing without proof, then completes valid verification and repeats same registration.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only verified valid identity is established; duplicate/invalid identity cannot occupy another account; correct verified visitor can proceed.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Accounts A/B with synthetic credentials referenced externally; logged-out browser, valid and wrong credentials.
items.action_and_variants: Submit wrong then correct A credentials, open A private page and request B's known private route.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Wrong login creates no private session; valid login accesses A only, B remains inaccessible.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Guest order O and contact channel; valid proof, wrong/expired proof and guessed order/contact information.
items.action_and_variants: Visitor requests order view and after-sales operation using order number alone, guessed data, invalid proof then valid channel proof.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: No ownership authorization until control verified; valid proof permits only corresponding order actions; guessed facts cannot expose order data.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Logged-in A and B with distinct profile markers; anonymous session.
items.action_and_variants: A reads/edits own profile, reloads and views modification record; A/anonymous attempt read/edit B via supported public boundary.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: A changes persist with verifiable history; B untouched and private; unauthorized responses do not return B fields.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: A has addresses A1/A2 and B has B1; signed-in and signed-out sessions.
items.action_and_variants: A adds A3, modifies A1, deletes A2, reloads address list/checkout choices; B and anonymous try A-address links.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only requested A records change and deleted A2 no longer selectable; A3 persists; unauthorized users cannot read A addresses.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: A/B accounts; variants V1/V2; V1 later unpublished and V2 out of stock.
items.action_and_variants: A favorites both, signs out/in, staff changes availability, A reopens favorites and removes V1; B opens own list.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: A selections survive sessions, retained variants show unlisted/out-of-stock state; removal persists; B list unaffected.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: A-owned orders, B-owned order, verified guest order not assigned to A, and A with no orders in separate run.
items.action_and_variants: A opens history, follows each own order entry and requests B/guest order known route.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only assigned A orders summarized and queryable; no implicit claim of unrelated guest order; empty history does not leak other users.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Purchased line eligible under published review rule; ineligible state, another customer's line and existing valid review controls.
items.action_and_variants: Customer submits score/text, reloads, submits again serially and concurrently for same line; attempt ineligible and foreign line.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: One effective review per qualified purchased line, with score/text/line and pending-review status; ineligible/foreign submissions not accepted as valid reviews.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Two pending reviews and authorized moderator; anonymous product page.
items.action_and_variants: Moderator publishes one and rejects other with reasons; visitor reloads product page; reopen staff review history.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Decisions/reasons recorded; only published review appears, pending/rejected text hidden from public.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Enabled plan with published currency-specific earn rule; eligible order just before and at required state, disqualified order, two currencies and live/test modes.
items.action_and_variants: Staff advances actual qualifying business event; customer views points history; replay event.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Exactly one traceable award for qualifying order under its currency/rule; premature/disqualified order earns none; repeat does not duplicate and test/live remain separate.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Enabled plan and account with independently calculated acquire/use/reversal/expiry history; include zero balance and pending holds.
items.action_and_variants: Customer opens balance and history before/after each event and expiry boundary.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Visible balance nonnegative and reconciles ledger; source orders and acquire/use/reverse/expiry records distinguishable, without hiding negative arithmetic behind misleading balance.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Enabled plan; balance B with existing hold H; valid and unsupported currency/rule cases; request B-H and one permitted point unit above; independent conversion oracle.
items.action_and_variants: Customer applies points at checkout and inspects quote/associated order; repeat from second checkout while first hold active.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only unheld eligible balance available under published currency conversion; excessive/unsupported redemption cannot lower payable amount; associated order recorded.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Original line award/redemption records and original rules; separate verified failure, cancellation and successful partial refund. Include cancel then refund same units and duplicate events.
items.action_and_variants: Execute corresponding business actions in differing orders; customer and staff inspect points ledger and independently calculate remaining adjustment.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Failure releases uncommitted redemption without award; cancel/refund adjust only actual eligible scope and outstanding delta; duplicate or overlapping events never reverse same entitlement twice.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Plan disabled, customer previously had test points; anonymous and member views.
items.action_and_variants: Browse product, cart, account and checkout and try prior redemption entry.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: No redeemable-points display or earning promise while disabled; stale entry cannot silently apply points.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: A logged in with profile/order tabs open; private request/session captured only in external secure test context.
items.action_and_variants: A logs out, refreshes tabs, uses back navigation and replays prior private request; attempt ordinary signed-out access.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Former session no longer authorizes private data; stale UI does not grant subsequent read/write access.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: A registered channel; wrong channel, expired reset proof and valid proof; previous credential known through secure reference.
items.action_and_variants: Request reset, attempt with wrong/expired proof, complete with valid proof; try old credential and reuse reset proof; log in with new credential.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only verified registered-channel holder resets; old credential and expired reset proof rejected; new credential authenticates intended account.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: A balance with one remaining redeemable unit, B separate balance, distinct currency ledgers and isolated test pool empty while real has balance.
items.action_and_variants: A submits two concurrent quotes requesting last unit, repeats same submission and attempts test/currency mismatch redemption.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: One correctly scoped hold per order; total never exceeds unheld A balance, no borrowing B/other currency/live pool; record includes order and mode.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Orders A/B each hold points; A verified paid, B uncertain/failed.
items.action_and_variants: Reconcile A payment twice and inspect account/order ledger before and after.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: A hold becomes one actual-use event; B not finalized; customer balance and reserved amount reconcile without duplicate deduction.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Orders with points holds for verified failure, never-started timeout, prepayment cancellation and uncertain payment, plus unrelated hold.
items.action_and_variants: Trigger each legal release twice and attempt timeout/release of uncertain order; inspect customer balance and histories.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only respective legal hold releases once; uncertain and unrelated holds remain; no new points created by repeated release.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Configured contact routes; service online and offline fixtures with actual availability known.
items.action_and_variants: Guest/member opens support before/after availability transition and follows displayed contact route.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Online/offline indicator agrees with service, usable contact routes shown without claiming unavailable staff online.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Online support, customer and authorized agent sessions, message with unique marker and recipient conversation identity.
items.action_and_variants: Customer sends message, both participants observe send status, reload/re-enter same conversation.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Message durably visible in correct conversation to both with accurate send state; no lost message after refresh or unrelated-conversation delivery.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Support offline; valid contact plus missing/invalid contact vectors.
items.action_and_variants: Guest leaves message with contact; correct rejected invalid contact; agent later opens follow-up queue and customer reopens conversation.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Valid message creates saved follow-up conversation and explains reply route; no false live-delivery claim; contact sufficient for stated route.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: A/B conversations with distinct messages; guest verified identity and member sessions; connection deliberately interrupted.
items.action_and_variants: A reconnects/re-enters, attempts without valid identity then verifies; request B conversation known link.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: After verification A history restored including pre-disconnect messages; unverified/foreign history not exposed.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Guest order with valid/invalid channel proof; A-owned and B-owned member orders; authorized and unrelated support agents.
items.action_and_variants: Customer associates each order, then each agent opens conversation order summary.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only verified guest or owner-member order can link; only authorized support sees necessary summary, no unrelated full customer details.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: No current owner; new online and offline conversations in authorized team's scope and another team's conversation.
items.action_and_variants: Customers start conversations; authorized agent/manager refreshes queue, unrelated employee opens same queue.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: New conversations marked unassigned and visible to authorized personnel; unauthorized customer details not exposed.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Unassigned conversation, two authorized assigners and agents A/B; notification receipt observation available.
items.action_and_variants: Assign A/B concurrently, reload queue/detail and inspect resulting responsibility and notifications.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: At each observable settled state exactly one responsible agent; notification matches effective assignment, no competing active owners.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Conversation assigned A with unread/unhandled message; authorized transfer actor and agent B.
items.action_and_variants: Transfer A to B with reason; both agents reopen queue and B opens history.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Original owner, new owner, reason/time recorded; B receives unfinished state and history, work not marked resolved or left with two owners.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Closed conversation with customer/agent history.
items.action_and_variants: Customer sends new message; agent opens follow-up queue and conversation; both reload.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Pending follow-up restored; original history retained and new message included, not silently lost in closed state.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Configured synthetic customer channel for guest/member; registered events: order state, paid, failed, shipped, after-sales decision, refund result, support reply; real/test modes where applicable.
items.action_and_variants: Cause each event via its customer/staff workflow; inspect captured recipient message and follow query/tracking/case/conversation link as recipient.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Corresponding status, payment mode where relevant, and next action correct; link leads to authorized correct record; old/other customer's status never substituted.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Guest order with no account and working checkout contact; registered notification events enabled.
items.action_and_variants: Cause order/payment/shipping/after-sales notification events; inspect checkout-channel receipt and follow link through guest verification.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Guest receives through checkout contact without account inbox dependency; correct guest order route and ownership challenge preserved.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Notification receiver fails for an order payment, shipment or refund event; before counts/balances recorded.
items.action_and_variants: Staff opens failure, retries notification after channel recovery and compares business records/receiver histories.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Failure cause and retryable state retained; delivery retry never repeats payment/refund/shipment or original state transition.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Missing channel configuration and configured-but-unavailable channel in separate cases; notification event pending.
items.action_and_variants: Cause notification event; staff opens exception queue and customer checks status.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Authorized staff sees actionable pending channel exception; no claim customer received undelivered message.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Authorized support worker with no selected conversation; run empty queue and nonempty unassigned queue.
items.action_and_variants: Open workspace directly and return to it after leaving a conversation.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Explicit select-conversation or wait-for-assignment instruction; no stale customer's conversation shown as current.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Authorized agent, reproducible network/service load failure at public boundary then restored availability.
items.action_and_variants: Open workspace during failure, activate displayed retry after recovery.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Visible fault with usable retry; retry actually loads authorized workspace, not endless false success or blank panel.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Agent authorized for queue A but not conversation B; B contains unique private marker.
items.action_and_variants: Agent opens B's known link and uses offered return action.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: B content refused/not disclosed; return reaches authorized queue, not another forbidden or stale conversation.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Conversation assigned agent A, unauthorized/unassigned B, customer online then disconnected.
items.action_and_variants: A sends reply with marker; customer reads live, disconnects, A sends second reply and customer re-enters; B attempts reply.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Authorized replies persist sender/content/time and are readable live or after re-entry; unauthorized reply cannot appear as valid assigned-agent reply.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: No-market fixture then two markets, each with one missing input in turn: brand/language, product/stock, price, licensed media, tax, delivery, applicable assembly, payment, after-sales, notification, support, runtime.
items.action_and_variants: Authorized employee opens readiness page for each market/configuration and expands gaps.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: No market explicitly reported; each category status and gap names affected variants/destinations; no generic green status concealing a scoped missing input.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Market with two variants: complete vs missing published data/price/stock independently; separate market where all variants fail.
items.action_and_variants: Employee runs transaction eligibility check then inspects each variant and market summary.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Readiness tied to each variant and its missing input; market with no passing variant explicitly has no tradable goods, not ready merely because catalog exists.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Variant A uses image lacking license/source; B fully licensed; unrelated content video lacks proof; independent omissions of license and source.
items.action_and_variants: Employee checks media/content readiness; customer tries quotes for A and B separately and opens content publishing check.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Affected media/content flagged with missing proof; A gap blocks A transaction; unrelated video gap does not block ready B transaction.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Market with destinations D1/D2 and bicycle/accessory; current tax, shipping and after-sales rules; omit each independently or make only future version available.
items.action_and_variants: Employee checks readiness; customer attempts quote for affected and unaffected combinations.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Affected destination/product marked unready with exact checkout blocker; future rule not treated effective; unaffected valid combination remains ready.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Configurations: verified real collection+refund, real collection but broken refund, unavailable real service, explicitly marked test, test without label and unconfirmed mode.
items.action_and_variants: Employee runs payment readiness check for each mode and opens missing-confirmation detail.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only verified real with working money/refund route qualifies for real readiness; labeled test only test; invalid/unconfirmed configurations unready with specific missing confirmation.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Configured/unconfigured/unavailable notification and support contacts, independently and together.
items.action_and_variants: Employee checks service readiness and opens affected customer contact routes.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Each missing/unusable service marked unready with affected contact path; presence of config alone not claimed working.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Domain/public service, private access control, backup and recovery results each absent/unverifiable independently; complete control.
items.action_and_variants: Employee opens readiness and relevant run-result references.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Every absent verification yields corresponding risk and action; backup record alone cannot stand for recovery verification; complete evidence discoverable.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Two independent gaps A/B with old verification time; authorized actor; actual input A corrected, B unchanged.
items.action_and_variants: Employee saves A and requests recheck, opens history; repeat with correction that still fails verification.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Related status recomputed from result, verifier/time/result retained; B not cleared; failed recheck not recorded ready merely because input saved.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Live and isolated test inventories, promo quotas, points, orders, reviews and metrics; live product source read-only. Test mode ready with synthetic resources.
items.action_and_variants: Customer completes test order/payment/review and refund including promotions/points; staff attempts live shipment and edits live source through test flow; compare all live balances/metrics and test records.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Test source labeled and all money/order/stock/benefits/reviews/metrics segregated; no live debit/refund/shipment or live mutable effect; product reference remains read-only.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Two markets, two variants and two destinations; baseline complete. Independently fail product/stock/media/policies/bicycle assembly and shared payment-refund/notification/support/runtime inputs; test-only payment control.
items.action_and_variants: Employee requests real-sale readiness for all combinations, then successively restores inputs to move none→partial→all.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only fully passing combinations ready; market summary none/partial/all accurate; local gap does not block unrelated combination, shared gap blocks its market, test payment never satisfies real requirement.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Test quote verifiable, explicit simulated payment, test inventory and required promo/points holds, physical-shipment guard. Remove each independently; benefit-free quote control.
items.action_and_variants: Employee requests test-flow readiness, customer exercises corresponding missing-input submit or shipping attempt.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Ready only with all applicable checks verifiable; unused benefits not mandatory; no fallback to live stock/rights, simulated success not real-sale readiness.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Ready variant A, unready B for D1, both ready for D2; real mode; single A cart and mixed A+B cart; receiver baseline.
items.action_and_variants: Customer attempts real payment for each cart/destination before and after B changes readiness; inspect public purchase promise and receiver.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Any failing line blocks entire charge and names line; no public real-purchase promise for failing line; A alone remains purchasable when ready; changing destination rechecks combination.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Bicycle models A/B and accessory-only market; omit A confirmed responsibilities, delivered form, deliverable guide or prepurchase assembly/policy separately.
items.action_and_variants: Employee checks readiness and customer opens A/B conditions; repeat accessory-only market with bicycle fields absent.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Each A gap names missing input and prevents A real sale; complete B unaffected; accessory-only market not blocked by inapplicable bicycle requirements.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Two enabled markets with distinguishable configured language/currency; signed-out and member sessions.
items.action_and_variants: Customer enters storefront for each market and opens product/cart.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Current market, applicable language and quote currency visible and consistent with that market, not stale previous setting.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: A/B enabled; variant V1 repriced in B, V2 only A, V3 only B; independent market prices not assumed exchange-rate conversions.
items.action_and_variants: Customer browses A, switches to B, inspects prior product/cart links and B catalog.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: B sellable set and independent quotes shown; prior V2 unavailable and V1 change marked; no stale A currency/price.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Disabled market D and enabled control E, with known market links.
items.action_and_variants: Customer selects/requests D directly, follows previous checkout link, then switches to E.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: D explains region unavailable and offers no D checkout path; enabled E remains usable.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Bicycle and accessory categories; published available, published out-of-stock and draft variants with unique names.
items.action_and_variants: Customer browses category and general catalog lists.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Configured categories and only published products displayed; out-of-stock clearly marked, drafts excluded.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Published bicycle/accessory with known name/category/brand/specs/price/currency/conditions; one lacks image.
items.action_and_variants: Customer opens each detail page and variant-independent buying information.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: All required fields accurately visible, specs backed by supplied data; no-image explicit instead of fabricated image; conditions not omitted.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Same product with two visually similar variants differing ID/spec/market price/availability.
items.action_and_variants: Customer switches variants repeatedly in markets A/B and proceeds to cart for sellable selection.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Selected unique ID/spec/price/availability all agree; last variant not accidentally reused.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Variant unlisted in current market and insufficient-stock variant separately; cart/exchange selected before availability change.
items.action_and_variants: Customer submits new confirmed order or staff requests exchange hold after change.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: No new payable order or exchange hold for unavailable variant; reason distinguishes market exclusion from shortage/available quantity.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Authorized product employee; existing P1/P2 and variants; full metadata including media source and market flags.
items.action_and_variants: Create product and variant, reopen before publication; edit P1/V1 fields, reopen P1/P2 and public catalog.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: New records identifiable and unpublished; specified categories/specs/market/price/media source/status saved; other records unchanged.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Draft bicycle/accessory with required category specs, market price and licensed media; omit each in turn and prepare complete control.
items.action_and_variants: Authorized employee presses Publish for each draft and checks public listing.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Each gap prevents publication with named missing field/evidence; complete genuine data can publish; another category's specs cannot substitute.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Variants V1/V2 with known counts; authorized operator; increase and decrease adjustments with reasons.
items.action_and_variants: Employee adjusts V1, reopens inventory history and checks V2.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: V1 before/after, reason, operator and time match action; V2 count unchanged.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Live/test V1 pools and V2 control; new order and approved-inspected exchange sources; separate missing-test-stock control.
items.action_and_variants: Customer submits quote or employee reserves exchange target; inspect visible stock/history and source links.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only corresponding-mode V1 availability decreases; history traces order/line or original line/case/target; V2 and opposite-mode pools unchanged; absent test pool cannot borrow live.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Holds for verified payment failure, never-started expiry, approved unpaid whole/paid line cancellation and pre-shipment exchange termination; uncertain payment control.
items.action_and_variants: Trigger each legal release, repeat and concurrently retry; inspect V1/V2 pools and history.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only associated variant/mode quantity restored once; invalid/uncertain release does not inflate stock; unrelated holds preserved.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Same-mode variant with N=1 free and another variant available; two orders, two exchanges, and order-vs-exchange pairs in separate runs.
items.action_and_variants: Submit quantity 1 and quantity 2 separately; race each pair for final unit through actual checkout/approved exchange actions.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Accepted total never exceeds 1; excess part refused with availability/shortage; no extra payable order/fulfillable exchange or cross-variant borrowing.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Published product whose media later returns unavailable response or inaccessible file; authorized alternate image absent.
items.action_and_variants: Customer opens catalog/detail on desktop/narrow screen.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Clear no-image state, no broken-image glyph or unlicensed substitute; product information readable.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Published bicycle with confirmed form, merchant/customer assembly responsibility, customer guide and policy link; omit each confirmation separately.
items.action_and_variants: Customer reads buying conditions then attempts quote for complete and incomplete model.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Complete model shows every required pre-purchase condition and working policy entry; incomplete model explicitly warns and cannot form payable quote.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Fresh uninitialized test deployment with approved bootstrap authorization reference; unauthorized visitor and initialized deployment controls.
items.action_and_variants: Authorized person performs initial setup; unauthenticated person attempts setup before and after it; authorized person repeats setup.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: First personal identifiable admin established only by controlled process; unauthorized/repeated initialization cannot create replacement or extra admin.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Authorized administrator and distinct proposed employee identities.
items.action_and_variants: Admin creates employee and reopens staff roster/audit.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Personal employee identity, creator and creation time saved rather than a shared untraceable account.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Employee logged in to two sessions with known role matrix; initially lacks a role, then receives it, then loses it.
items.action_and_variants: Admin grants role, employee performs newly permitted action; admin revokes, employee repeats from existing tab/session and new navigation.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Grant allows matching action; revocation immediately blocks subsequent action in all existing sessions; role change history recorded.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Employee lacking each product/order/refund/content/customer-data capability; snapshots of target records and authorized control user.
items.action_and_variants: Attempt each forbidden action through UI and supported external request using known record identifiers; inspect records as authorized user.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: All forbidden actions refused without business-record changes or private fields; authorized control can perform permitted counterpart.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Product operator permitted catalog fields but not other business fields; target P1 and unrelated P2.
items.action_and_variants: Operator edits permitted fields through product management, attempts extra unauthorized field mutation via supported interface, reopens records.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only granted product/variant/market-price/publication fields changed through catalog behavior; unauthorized field and P2 preserved.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Inventory employee; counted versus recorded stock differ; blank reason and valid reason vectors.
items.action_and_variants: Submit adjustment without reason, then with reason; reopen adjustment history.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Missing reason prevents adjustment; accepted adjustment retains before/after/count delta, cause, operator and time.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Orders/packages/exceptions within and outside employee scope; legal next and forbidden skipped state.
items.action_and_variants: Employee opens queue, handles legal task and attempts forbidden progression and out-of-scope task.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only authorized work visible; legal update persists, invalid state jump blocked, unrelated records unchanged.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Role matrix separates cancellation approval, return/exchange review and refund execution; cases ready for each.
items.action_and_variants: Each role attempts all three actions using actual staff entry; inspect case decision records.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only corresponding role permissions permit action; denial leaves case unchanged; accepted action records decision basis.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Manager authorized for subset of conversations and assignments/transfers; private out-of-scope customer marker.
items.action_and_variants: Manager opens queue, assigns and transfers permitted item, requests out-of-scope conversation/customer data.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only accessible assignable/transferable tasks and necessary data shown; unprivileged customer details hidden.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Tax, delivery, warranty, return, promotion and notification rules with approved fields; old active V1 and proposed V2 future; missing required field per type.
items.action_and_variants: Authorized employee saves/activates each, observes before and at effective time, retries missing-value rule.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Scope/time/version/operator persisted; incomplete rules cannot activate; applicable effective version used, not merely last edited.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Authorized changes in price, inventory, order, refund, points, roles, publication and support transfer; ordinary employee read access.
items.action_and_variants: Perform each change, view audit, then ordinary employee attempts editing/deleting through available controls/supported boundary.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Each event has accountable sensitive-change record; ordinary employee cannot delete/alter it; original event still viewable.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Known fixtures across two markets and periods with real/test orders, sales, pending shipments, returns and support backlog; independently calculated totals.
items.action_and_variants: Authorized employee filters each market/time including boundaries and toggles real/test view if offered; compare figures.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Metrics match included records and distinguish test from real; wrong market/time or test transactions cannot inflate real totals.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Known pending-shipment, return and support backlog records within selected market/time; zero-count control.
items.action_and_variants: Employee opens each exception indicator and compares resulting task identifiers/counts to contributing records.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Queue supports verifying corresponding metric with consistent scope; no unrelated default queue or missing contributing exception.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Active employee in two sessions; admin identity known.
items.action_and_variants: Admin disables employee; disabled employee reloads private views and submits a previously permitted action.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Actor/time recorded; every subsequent access blocked, including old session; protected business state unchanged.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Admin, employee registered controlled channel, invalid/expired proof and valid proof vectors.
items.action_and_variants: Admin initiates reset; employee tries without/invalid verification then completes valid channel verification.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Initiator/time recorded; reset cannot complete before verified identity; valid employee can finish through controlled channel.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Guest/member confirmed mixed bicycle/accessory quote, quantity 3 on one line with non-even minor-unit allocation; discount, points, tax and shipping; real/test modes. Independent allocation worksheet follows supplied policy.
items.action_and_variants: Customer confirms quote to create pending order; owner/authorized staff opens detail or supported export and compares every field in confirmed snapshot table to quote/worksheet.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Order ID/owner-contact/time, exact variants/quantities/prices/currency, per-unit discount/points/tax/shipping and rounding recipient, tax basis, address/service/fee/estimate, total/mode/policy versions all preserved; unit allocations sum to quoted totals.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Existing order snapshot/export and current catalog/policy version recorded.
items.action_and_variants: Authorized employee changes product details, price and policy; owner reopens old order then creates a new quote.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Old order's complete transaction snapshot unchanged; new quote reflects current values without overwriting history.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Verified guest, unverified guest, owner member, other member, authorized employee and unauthorized employee; order with payment/fulfillment/after-sales events.
items.action_and_variants: Each identity requests order detail from known link; authorized identities reopen after an event.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only authorized owner/employee sees current states and event times; other identities refused, guest number alone insufficient.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Fresh order/package per transition in confirmed table; payment pending/unknown/paid/failed/expired/closed; fulfillment pending-payment/pending-fulfillment/picking/packed/shipped/delivered/cancelled; refund none/partial/full.
items.action_and_variants: For each explicit matrix edge perform corresponding customer/staff/external action, inspect all dimensions and source/reason/time; attempt each forbidden target, including paid→failed after refund and shipped→cancelled.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Only permitted qualified edge changes its dimension; failed/expired retries create related new order; refund does not erase paid/shipping history; transport exception is annotation, after-sales request is not cancellation/refund.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Real paid authorized order, unpaid order, unknown-payment order and simulated-paid order; bicycle and accessory lines.
items.action_and_variants: Fulfillment worker starts picking and marks ready to dispatch for each line/fixture.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Qualified lines show their picking/ready status; unpaid/unknown cannot advance and test success alone cannot authorize physical fulfillment.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Bicycle model with applicable confirmed packaging checklist; two packages, pass and failed checklist item.
items.action_and_variants: Packager records each check and exception, saves and reopens package record.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Applicable checks, performer and actual abnormal result retained on correct package, failure not silently converted to all-pass.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Delivered-form policy specifies merchant/customer responsibilities; two bicycle models with different assignments and guide versions.
items.action_and_variants: Staff prepares each bicycle delivery and records performed/customer-required assembly and accompanying guide; customer opens delivered instructions.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Correct model/policy-specific responsibilities and actual guide recorded and available; merchant work not misattributed to customer or vice versa.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Paid mixed order with separate bicycle/accessory packages and distinct estimates.
items.action_and_variants: Staff ships accessory while bicycle still preparing; customer views order; later ship bicycle.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Each package/line status independent and each item's expected arrival identifiable; first shipment does not falsely mark all shipped.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Ready package with verified carrier service, tracking ID, dispatch time and source evidence; second package control.
items.action_and_variants: Employee records actual dispatch and customer opens tracking; refresh after update.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Correct carrier/tracking/time/evidence persist for dispatched package; customer sees update time, second package unaffected.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Dispatched package with previous carrier status/time; no first result and later polling failure in separate fixtures.
items.action_and_variants: Customer opens tracking during unavailable response and after recovery.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Source and last update clearly shown; failure/no data not delivered; recovery displays actual subsequent status.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Two packages in same order with separate IDs; verifiable delivered event for first, unverified claim control.
items.action_and_variants: Staff applies/verifies first carrier delivery and customer opens both; attempt unverified claim for second.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: First records source/time and delivered status; second unchanged until its own verifiable delivery, no order-wide fabricated arrival.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Delivered mixed order with one damaged bicycle package and undamaged accessory; owner evidence and report time known.
items.action_and_variants: Owner reports damage from bicycle package, uploads synthetic evidence, submits and follows after-sales entry.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Report preserves correct package/item/description/evidence/time; queryable linked case, accessory not mistakenly implicated.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Test-paid order and authorized fulfillment worker; real dispatch receiver baseline.
items.action_and_variants: Worker attempts create physical shipment from test order via UI and supported boundary.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Physical dispatch task rejected and no real carrier request; test-payment status explicitly not authorization.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Paid package ready for picking; each picking, dispatch and delivered action has known source/reference.
items.action_and_variants: Repeat same action serially and concurrently at each stage; inspect package history/state and dispatch receiver.
