items.incorrect_behavior_detection: No duplicate business effect or state regression from repetitions; single package not dispatched twice or counted delivered twice.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Three-line split order with one cancelled, one shipped, one preparing; later first delivery, partial refund and pending after-sales; then all remaining fulfilled.
items.action_and_variants: Customer opens summary and detailed timeline after each transition.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Partial/all shipping, delivery and cancellation accurately derived; refund/after-sales displayed separately; earlier events and per-line reality retained.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Qualified exchange with original delivered package, inspected original return, target hold, settled difference and authorization.
items.action_and_variants: Staff requests replacement, dispatches and records verified delivery; owner follows original and replacement links.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: New independent package links original line, case and exact target variant; only replacement follows its actual progress, original history preserved.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Published match in A, match only B, matching draft, unrelated item; keyword yielding none; guest/member.
items.action_and_variants: Search matching and no-result keywords in A, switch B and repeat.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Results relevant and restricted to current market published products; empty result explicit with usable browse entry.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Catalog where different items satisfy category/spec/price/availability individually but only one satisfies all; prices at chosen range bounds and outside.
items.action_and_variants: Apply all filters, verify set, remove each one in turn and then clear all.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Every displayed item satisfies remaining combined filters; clearing one preserves others and restores only newly eligible items; boundary inclusion matches stated filter.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Filtered products with distinct and tied prices/spec sort values; documented sort choices.
items.action_and_variants: Select each offered sort order then reverse/change it while filters remain active.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Results obey advertised ordering, tied values do not break filtering; filters and membership retained rather than resetting catalog.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Two comparable published bicycles/accessories with known differing specs and one absent value.
items.action_and_variants: Customer selects products for comparison and reads corresponding fields side by side.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Correct products/specs aligned; missing value explicitly unknown, not zero or copied from other product.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Two bicycle models/sizes with different merchant-supplied geometry/ranges, source labels.
items.action_and_variants: Customer opens fit information and switches model/variant.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Applicable size ranges, geometry and model/variant attribution match supplied data, not stale or generalized dimensions.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Confirmed sizing rules with input dimensions/preferences and independently derived candidate sets; fixtures inside each interval and preference-driven different result.
items.action_and_variants: Customer enters complete dimensions/preferences for each vector and submits fit request.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Returned candidate frame sizes and explanation match provided rule; recommendation changes when a rule-relevant input changes.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Confirmed rule boundaries; vectors shared adjacent-size edge, one step outside supported range, and each required body/model input missing.
items.action_and_variants: Customer submits fit inputs, reads guidance and follows supplement/manual-confirmation path.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Boundary shows justified candidate sizes and posture checks; out-of-range says not applicable/manual confirmation; missing input named; none claims uniquely correct size.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Two bicycle/accessory variants, one verified compatible and one verified incompatible with sources/time.
items.action_and_variants: Customer selects each pairing and opens compatibility details.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Verified conclusion, exact model/spec and source or verification time shown; other variant's conclusion not reused.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Pairing with missing interface/dimension data, expired verification, or record for different selected variant.
items.action_and_variants: Customer selects each pair and opens fit/consultation path.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Cannot-confirm state with specific missing spec, last verification time or variant mismatch; usable specification/support path, no unsupported compatibility guarantee.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Authorized employee and two models with existing fit/compatibility records; new valid record changes one conclusion.
items.action_and_variants: Employee updates source/model/verifier/time and data; customer reopens affected and control pair.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Updated metadata persists and affected public conclusion follows effective data; control model unchanged and obsolete conclusion not retained.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Reproducible browser/device matrix containing desktop and narrow viewport from agreed target range; guest/member/employee fixtures for search-cart, quote-order lookup, after-sales-chat and staff queues.
items.action_and_variants: At each viewport actually search/add/change cart, complete quote/view order, submit after-sales/send/read support reply, process authorized order/support queue task; rotate/resize midway and inspect overflow.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Required content and actions visible and completable without horizontal obstruction; no lost totals, hidden submit control or inaccessible staff queue after reflow. Evidence includes task completion at each viewport.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Main catalog/detail/cart/checkout/order/content views with long titles, absent image and mixed image proportions; desktop/narrow display.
items.action_and_variants: Customer navigates each page and identifies product info and primary action; capture comparable views for human visual assessment.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Typography/color/image proportions/spacing/hierarchy consistently communicate products and actions; stretched images, clipped labels or visually indistinguishable primary action fail qualitative review.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Guest/member/employee main-task fixtures as in responsive scenario; pointer unused after initial browser focus.
items.action_and_variants: Use Tab/Shift-Tab/Enter/Space and applicable standard keys to search, select variant, edit cart, submit checkout fields, query order, submit case and operate support; include dialogs/errors.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Visible focus, logical traversal and usable controls permit task completion; no keyboard trap or unreachable critical action; recording shows focus progression.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Supported assistive reader and accessibility inspection at user boundary; forms, informative/decorative images, validation errors, payment/status and quote changes.
items.action_and_variants: Navigate/read forms and images with assistive tool, submit invalid field, change shipping/quantity and trigger status update.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Meaningful labels/appropriate alternatives and perceivable changed status/fees; user can identify field/error/result without seeing layout; decorative images not misleadingly announced as products.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Registration/address/checkout/after-sales forms and cart/support actions; one invalid field and controlled external failure per operation.
items.action_and_variants: Submit invalid input or trigger failure, read message, correct/retry from offered control and finish valid action.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Specific problem identified and working correction/retry path; valid continuation succeeds without unexplained blank state or loss of necessary context.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Published product, category and article pages with distinct content; browser and unauthenticated HTTP client available.
items.action_and_variants: Open and fetch each public URL, inspect delivered document/title/description/canonical and visible body; follow canonical.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Readable URL, page-specific title/description, indexable substantive text and correct canonical; no all-pages-identical title or canonical to unrelated page.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Draft/withdrawn content, account/checkout, internal search and employee routes; public sitemap/indexing metadata accessible.
items.action_and_variants: Fetch sitemap and each route anonymously plus authorized boundary where needed; inspect indexing declaration and public entries.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Excluded route classes absent from public sitemap and never declare themselves indexable; public discovery does not reveal unpublished/private content.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: A/B accounts, orders, support conversations and employee records plus nonexistent IDs; guest/member/low-privilege employee sessions.
items.action_and_variants: A or unprivileged user requests B and nonexistent resources via known public routes, read and modification attempts; compare responses and owner-visible state.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Both unauthorized-existent and nonexistent requests avoid sensitive existence/detail disclosures; forbidden data/change unavailable, owner data unchanged.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Approved authentication/sensitive-action limit L and time window, transport/session policy, synthetic identities; external secret references only.
items.action_and_variants: Attempt invalid login/sensitive operations below/at/above L, try valid user after allowed recovery window; inspect browser-visible transport/session handling without recording secret values.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Configured abuse limits enforced at defined boundary with recoverable legitimate use; credentials/session data protected in transit and exposed browser surfaces per approved policy. Missing thresholds/policy are execution-oracle gaps, not invented defaults.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Approved purposes/policy and contact/request process; synthetic account with collected personal data.
items.action_and_variants: Customer reaches each collection point, opens policy, submits access, correction and deletion/retention request through provided entries.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Approved purpose and applicable policy available; each required request path usable with queryable acknowledgement appropriate to configured process; no claim of immediate deletion where only request is required.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Synthetic unique password/payment-shaped/contact markers, no live credentials; public error surfaces and authorized ordinary-log view.
items.action_and_variants: Trigger normal business events and failed submissions containing synthetic sensitive markers; inspect responses and ordinary logs via supported operational boundary.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: No password/full payment credential/unnecessary personal marker exposed; logs still correlate event/error without secret. Evidence records marker labels/redacted findings, not credential values.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Order submission, payment, refund and support-message workflows; external interruption before acknowledgement and receiver accepted-but-response-lost vectors; original references/counts known.
items.action_and_variants: Perform action through user UI, interrupt response, reload and retry through offered flow; inspect staff reconciliation and external receiver outcomes.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Understandable pending/failure state and reconcilable original record retained; retry does not duplicate respective business effect; unknown money result not falsely finalized.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Unresolved checkout/payment/refund or notification error affecting known records, plus unrelated staff role; approved persistence threshold if defined.
items.action_and_variants: Cause failure to remain unresolved, authorized employee opens operations exception view, follows affected records, then resolve and revisit; unauthorized employee requests details.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Authorized staff sees concrete error, scope and handling status across persistence/resolution; unrelated staff does not gain private data; unresolved error cannot vanish without outcome.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Approved backup plan and declared covered datasets/recovery point; reproducible known order/inventory/account/audit data; successful and failed backup attempts.
items.action_and_variants: Authorized operator executes backup through supported operational command/interface and opens result report.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Actual success/failure, covered dataset scope and declared recovery point saved; failed/incomplete backup never reported as successful full coverage.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Approved restore plan, completed backup with known reference records and declared recovery point; later mutations distinguish old/new state; isolated restore target.
items.action_and_variants: Operator performs restore drill through supported operation; use app/authorized export on restored target to verify order, stock, account and audit records against saved point; record missing-dataset failure control.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: All four datasets recover to declared point and verifiable drill result saved; merely starting restore not success, missing/inconsistent dataset fails; no production destructive action assumed.

items.operation_modes_and_user_states: Formally confirmed visual specification with fonts/colors/image treatments and target pages; valid licensed assets; no invented brand decisions.
items.action_and_variants: Customer opens catalog/detail/cart/checkout/content at target viewports; reviewer compares rendered font/color/image treatment against each specified value/example.
items.incorrect_behavior_detection: Published pages match confirmed standard; deviations documented per page. Without formal standard this conditional execution remains unproven, never self-approved with an invented look.
